GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-08-09T22:43:52Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Search query doesn't work when additional parameters are added inside loop
Description: ```
I have a strange issue with mailkit:


        string[] fromAuthors = new string[] { "@something.com", "@something2.com", "@somethingelse.net" };

        SearchQuery query = SearchQuery.FromContains(fromAuthors[0]);
        for (int i = 1; i < fromAuthors.Length; i++)
        {
            query.Or(SearchQuery.FromContains(fromAuthors[i]));
        }
```

This doesn't work, `inbox.Search(query)` returns results for only the first entry  (in this case "@something.com"), everything else is being ignored.

While this:

```
     SearchQuery query = SearchQuery.FromContains(fromAuthors[0]).Or(SearchQuery.FromContains(fromAuthors[1])) 
```

works fine, and results for both emails are being returned...
